records.source: AND THEN IT CATCHES UP. The wheel for a release cannot contain its own release note -- the note is written when the GitHub release is published, which is after that wheel is on PyPI -- so a bundled file is always one release behind the build carrying it, and that is what went wrong: "im on 1.5.1.0 and the news only goes to 1.5.0.7. the news section should always automatically reflect the latest spacr release news."
